tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bla ma'i rnam 'byor nyams su len tshul 'dod dgu'i dpal ster bzhugs so// swasti/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tsha lung rdo rje'i brag khrod du rta mgrin yang gsang gi nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i tshe/ lan cig thugs nyams 'ur nas de skor gyi ri thams cad skad cig nyid la myur bas rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang mngon sum du mjal nas nga'i sku 'dra bzhengs shig zhes lung bstan nas bzhengs pa'i lung bstan sku 'dra rin po che thub bstan dge 'phel na bzhugs pa 'di la gsol ba btab na/ spyir bstan 'gro'i bde skyid dang / bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rabs chad med myur 'byon la shin tu khyad che bar yod ces tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsang ba'i rnam thar du gsungs pa ltar don gnas bstar chags su byung bas/ sa skya pa'i gdung rabs kyi ched 'di la gsol ba 'debs pa shin tu gal che/ de'i tshul spyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor mi 'dra ba du ma byung yang / 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis rje btsun rin po che la dmigs bsal sbyar ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung ngu zhig mdzad 'dug pa de gzhir bzung nas 'dir brjod par bya'o/ /de yang lang mkhar dge 'phel na bzhugs pa'i lung bstan sku 'dra'am/ grags pa'i mtha' can bzhis bzhengs pa sogs rje btsun rin po che'i sku brnyan khyad par can rnams kyi drung du/ chu bzhi'am gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga sbreng tshar gyis thog drangs sna lnga'i mchod pa brgya tshar sogs ci 'byor bshams/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams kyi mdun rdo dril gos zung maṇ+ḍal 'bru bcas dri bzang gi chu rnga rol dung sogs bshams la mchod pa byin rlabs chu bzhi ma ltar na kyai rdor bzhin dang / chu gnyis ma ltar na/ tshe dpag med ltar brjod la skyabs yul rje btsun gyi sku de nyid mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsams pa'i skyabs 'gro ci mang skyabs gsol gyi tshig dang bcas pa/

sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs/ sems bskyed bla mchod kyi dbu bzhin/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis sku rten stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che gser gyi khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa/ dpal sa skya pa chen po grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rab mdzes dge bsnyen mchog gi sku can mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar zhing / lha dang mi'i rgyu bzang las grub pa'i na bza' dkar pos bod chas su gsol ba/ gdul bya'i rgyud la grub gnyis bde blag tu stsol ba'i phyir rigs lnga'i phyag rgya dang phyag mtshan 'dzin pa sogs phyag stabs nges med sna tshogs su sku 'dra rnams la gang yod de gsal btab chog mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas zab mo rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ thugs bde stong dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par 'jog bzhin pa/ bdag la dges pa'i 'dzum mdangs can/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi mchog stsol ba'i sku can du gyur/ de'i mtha' skor du bla ma/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan thos rang rgyal/ chos srung nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min/ bde ba can/ u rgyan/ gser mdog can la sogs pa'i zhing khams nas rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la skyabs gnas dam pa thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim pas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs par gyur/ de nas gsol 'debs spyi bye brag bya ste/ lam zab/ lam 'bras/ bde phur/ gur/ zhal/ sdom gsum/ phar/ tshad la sogs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol 'debs rang blos gang shes dang / thub dbang / byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs kyi bstod pa dang / bir bstod gong bstod nas bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma la thug gi bar gyi bstod pa gsol 'debs ci shes bya/ bye brag rje btsun rin po che la gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo la gsol ba btab tshar ba'i rjes su bdag la skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dman ci byung yang khyed las skyabs gzhan med snyam du blo ling gis bkal/ kha tshig tsam ma yin par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gdung shugs drag po bskyed de/ ngag tu dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs sh+lau ka gcig chos rnams kun gyi de nyid gzigs sogs la grangs bzung ste brgya stong sogs ci nus bton/ gsol 'debs 'di byin rlabs shin tu che ste/ rje btsun rin po che nyid bzhugs pa'i skabs/ dkar shākya grags sogs slob ma rnams phyogs gzhan du 'byon tshe thugs dam skyabs 'jug zhus pas na/ phyag gnyis slob ma de'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ gsung las khyed rang nga dge bsnyen rgan po mgo se yod re bsam par gyis la/ chos rnams kun gyi de nyid gzigs sogs gsol ba thob cig dang / mi bslu bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa yin pas byin rlabs shin tu che/ gsol 'debs de yang sa skya'i gdung rabs myur 'byon kho na yin tshe/ chos rnams ma'i mjug la phyag 'tshal gyi rjes su/ lha rigs 'khon gdung sa skya pa'i gdung rabs chad med myur 'byon shog ces dang / dus min 'chi bzlog lta bu yin na/

bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes sogs rang gang mos kyi 'dod gsol sbyar zhing / spyir btang phal cher la/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /zhes sbyar nas grangs bzung / de'i rjes su yon tan rgya mtsho ma sogs/ bod dang rgya gzhung gi bstod pa rgyas pa rnams gang shes dang / khyad par gdung rabs myur 'byon yin na kho bos brtsams pa'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang / zhal dkar rje drung ngag dbang shes rab kyis mdzad pa'i phan bde'i 'byung gnas sogs kyi sgo nas rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab/ gzhan yang 'dod gsol gang shes brjod/ de nas sa paṇa gyi sku bstod sogs chos spyod kyi 'phro rnams byas la/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs kyi rnam dbye ni gong gi des shes/ 'bul tshig chu bzhi ma ltar na kyai rdor bzhin la/ rje btsun 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /ces dang / chu gnyis ma ltar na rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma sogs sbyar bas chog gnyis ka la mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra bhāṭ+ṭa ra ka kirti dh+wa dza sa pa ri wā ra zhes sbyar la rol mo'i bar dbul/ oṃ sarba bid sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya byas la/ rgyal srid sna bdun sogs sprul nas bde bar gshegs pa sogs dang / kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyis 'bul/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ mos blos rje btsun 'khor bcas la 'bul na/ /zhes sbyar maṇ+ḍal grangs gsog byed tshe/ dri bzang brlan dang bcas pas/ tshom bu bdun ma lan nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub dang / 'bru yang yang kha gsos la/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma brgya tshar sogs/ mthar tshom bu so bdun ma lan gsum bdun sogs ci 'grub phul la/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang / deng nas byang chub sogs bya/ sdig bshags grangs gsog byed na/ bgyis dang bgyid stsal bgyis la yi rang ba'i/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams/

/'gro ba kun gyis bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / /lhan cig rab nongs sdom pa'i sems gyis bshags/ /zhes tshe 'dir sdig che ba zhig gis thog drangs/ 'gyod dgos thams cad la snying thag pa nas bshags 'bul gyi tshig de brgya stong sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ skyabs sems kyi sdom pa len pa ni thal mo sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum brjod/ nus na bdag ni thog med ma yongs rdzogs/ bsdu na bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa shin tu bsdu na phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig zhen pa spang ba dang / dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i longs spyod kyi dngos po dang / btang snyoms pa bar ma'i sems can thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul ba bgyi'o/ /bdag gti mug dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs/ gdon thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsum/ bdag gi gnyen bshes/ mdza' grogs/ lha thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag 'dod chags dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsum/ bdag gis bdag tu bzung ba'i longs spyod kyi dngos po thams cad/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag ser sna dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsum/ rang tha mal par gnas pa'i lag pa g.yas par ye shes kyi ral gri ngar dang ldan pa thogs nas smin mtshams nas ltag pa'i bar bcad de mdun du mi mgo'i sgyed pu blos 'khyud tshad gsum gyi steng du thod ya gan rkyal bsgyel nas dpral ba rang la bstan nas bzhag de nas rkang pa g.yas pa dum bur gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin rkang pa g.yon pa dum bur/ lag pa g.yon pa mgo bo'i lhag ma/ ro stod/ nang khrol rnams/ ro smad/

mthar lag pa g.yas pa ral gri dang bcas pa dum bu dum bur byas nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ 'di'i dmigs pa las dang po rnams cung blor mi tshud cing mi bde na'ang / don bsgom mi bde rgyu cung zad tsam yang med de sems snang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas rang rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i kyai rdo rje he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ thod pa'i nang gi sha rus rnams rgyas par spro na kyai rdor gyi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pas mchod par bsam la/ ngag tu rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi༞ yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi༞ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i༞ 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams kyi༞ dgra bcom nyan thos rnams kyi༞ dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma'i༞ gnod sbyin nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dges shing tshim nas dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ pha ma la sogs rigs drug gi sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gnyer ba'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod byed thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan chags dang bu lon thams cad khyer zhing sha 'khon du gnyer ba byang nas gnod sems ma lus pa zhi bar gyur cig bdud rtsi'i lhag ma snod dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang 'jig rten khams 'dir bcud len gyi rdzas thams cad dang / sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga yongs su sbyar ba'i zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po skyed par byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la 'bul bar bgyi'o/

/bde ba chen po'i ye shes phyin ci ma log par myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ltos pa med par phul/ gsang mchod ni/ rang gi sems kyis sprul pa'i rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa phul zhing / bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud gang bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas/ mchod yul/ mchod mkhan rnams rang sems dang dbyer med par de kho na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can dngos yin snyam du mos gus khyad par can snying khongs rus pa'i gting nas dung dung pa byas la ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /lus ngag yid gsum la dbang bzhi stsal du gsol/ tshar gcig ces gsol ba btab nas nor lha rnams 'od du zhu/ chos skyong la thim/ de nyan thos la thim/ de rang sangs rgyas la thim/ de byang sems la thim/ de sangs rgyas la thim/ de yi dam la thim/ de brgyud pa'i bla ma la thim/ de rtsa ba'i rang gis dbang thob kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma min kyang de dang dbyer med cing / skyabs gnas thams cad sprul pa po yin pas skyon med/ bla ma la thim zhes brjod cing bsam/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam du mos gus drag po byas la/ ngag tu/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dang / oṃ yig gi phreng ba byung / rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi nang gang / lus rtsa'i dri ma sbyangs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dang / āḥyig gi phreng ba byung / rang gi mgrin par thim/ lus kyi nang gang / ngag yi ge'i dri ma sbyangs/

gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po dang / hūm̐ yig gi phreng ba byung / rang gi sna sgo g.yon nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang / snying gar yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par gyur/ yid bdud rtsi'i dri ma sbyangs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang / yi ge 'bru gsum gyi phreng ba byung / rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus kyi nang gang / lus ngag yid gsum dang / snying po ye shes rlung gi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs te lhan skyes kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ zhes brjod cing / cung zad mnyam par gzhag slar yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad par spangs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas rje btsun gyi/ sku las sku gnyis pa zhig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon nas/ rang gi spyi bor zhugs pa de bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu ste rang la gnyis su med par thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres te bde stong gi rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod la/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par gzhag de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /sogs bla mchod kyi mjug bzhin bkra shis kyi bar bya'o/ /yang bsdus pa la dga' na/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung / ye shes pa spyan 'dren bstim gyi bar gong bzhin la/ rje btsun gyi gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gang shes bya/ zhen pa spang ba nas bzung nyams su blangs la bsngo smon shis brjod skabs sbyar bya/

shin tu bsdu na sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi gsung bzhin no/ /yang sku rten med par nam mkhar bskyed tshe/ mar me gcig las gnyis mched de mi dgos par bla ma rje btsun rin po che 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par zhes sbyar bas 'thus so/ /zhes rje btsun rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa gtso bo dpal sa skya pa'i gdung rabs myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs dang / zhar la rnam gzhag gzhan yang ston pa 'di ni snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sa skya'i gdung rabs nyag phra skabs gdan sa nas gang ci'i rim gro bsgrubs mus dang chabs cig par dge 'phel sku 'dra rin po che la mchod 'bul gsol 'debs zhig bgyis na legs 'dra zhes mdzod pa shes rab phun tshogs kyis bskul ma dang / de bstun dpal sa skya'i chos grwa rnam gnyis nas dge 'dun brgyad grwa zhig mchod 'bul gsol 'debs bskang 'phrin gyi yo byad bcas dge 'phel du ched brdzangs bgyis skabs sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di bzhin lhag bsam rnam dag gis kun nas bslangs te/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / bla mchod 'chi med go 'phang sbyin pa la gzhi byas/ zhen pa spang ba sogs sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lam zab phyi ma'i nyams len nas kha bskangs te rang bzo med par sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
